title: SpaceSquat — tentative roadmap
note: Tentative. Edit this file to change what the in-game roadmap (R) shows. Status: done | now | next | later.

phases.name: Phase 0 — Sandbox (Clone 1)
phases.goal: Prove the loop is fun on a single machine.

items.text: Flight, GTA2-style camera (the "gravity" feel stays)
48 lots on the Spine: 1.13× buy-out, credits not cash
Idiot-proof terminals + full ownership ledger (Tab)
Seeded drops (the bear turd), sight-radius levelling
Freight jobs, heat/drones, Spine Run
The Sprawl: scrap-built huts, never branded
Generated sprite art with canvas fallbacks

phases.name: Phase 1 — Staging on spacesquat.fun
phases.goal: Get it live, play it, write notes in-game, tune.

items.text: FTP secrets in, first deploy to spacesquat.fun
In-game notes (N) + roadmap (R), export to Markdown
$1 lots, ×1.25 buy-outs in cents; towers grow with value (skyline); NPC corps claim $1 lots
Starter skiff #001 handles like garbage on purpose; scrap-only upgrades at the Kessler Refit Bay
Onboarding flow part 1 (v0.1.2): M1 fix the skiff, M2 get a home, bulletin-immune, objective flag
Onboarding flow part 2: TBD (first freight run? first $1 lot? EVA certification at the Science Centre?)
Ship-to-ship jump (<3s exposure); stolen ships revert to your skiff after 2 min
Wiki: lore for the 13 organizations, places, glossary. In-game on L, docs/WIKI.md, project wiki (all from data/lore.json)
Logos for the 13 organizations (Kevin generating; names are drafts) — in (v0.1.5); names still drafts

Rule of 13 conversion (v0.1.3): 169 lots in 13 blocks of 13 (north side) with crossings, two Sprawls (east + west, 39 sites each), 13 tiers everywhere, 13 orgs in-world, $13 test cash, 13 drops per window. Everything except max building height
Residency card: 13 sites run by the 13 orgs, levels 0.01→0.13 → Level 1 ('Fully Processed') — v0.1.4 (stand-in desk actions for systems that don't exist yet)

Achievements: 13 categories × 13 known (169) + 169 hidden; shame ones hidden until first earned, pay a cosmetic once; others pay scrap/resources — v0.1.4: framework + 48 live; the other 121 known + 169 hidden still to write
v0.2: simple registration, Google sign-in (Gmail only), test data wiped later; issues real skiff numbers from #001
Balance pass: drop rates, heat speeds, hut prices, Sprawl flight time
Check Firefox, Safari, a slow laptop
Touch controls, or a clear desktop-only notice
Feedback button + privacy-friendly analytics before outside testers
Art round 2: top-down race gate, more rooftops, explosion/busted frames
Sound: thrusters, drop pings, sirens, ambient hum

REVISIT (Kevin, Nov 7: placeholder looks rough): better Architect imagery. Proper Wilco logo + Prime Rogue roof treatment; two top-down tower roofs (arch_roof_primerogue, arch_roof_wilco); two campus plaza tiles. Drop-in paths: assets/architects/<id>.png (roof) and <id>_card.png (card)
Wilco's daily inspection patrol: top-down dog sprite (4-frame walk), patrol route, goodies left behind (scrap/cosmetics only)

phases.name: Phase 2 — Multiplayer core
phases.goal: Real people fighting over the same lots and the same turds.

items.text: Realtime server (Cloudflare Durable Objects, or Node + WebSocket on a Canadian VPS)
Accounts: guest session upgradable to email login, minimal PII
Server-authoritative drops, claims and movement (the real bot defence)
Postgres: lots, ledger, credits, huts
Buy-out notifications (in-game + transactional email, CASL-safe)
See other pilots, people-online counter, chat?
Skiff registry: numbers issued at signup from #001, never sold
Skiffs unused 13 days → number goes to the ship lot; 69-hour auctions, in-game currency only, planet-wide announcement
Spine Security: a skiff on the Spine triggers a security-force chase (no hard rule)
Dynamic return locations (detention centre, impound yard, etc.)
Buyable vehicles (scrap) after the upgrade routes; Road Chassis unlock

Tenure Heights + Ministry of the Gentry: gentry = lots or credits; 13-day demotion; scrapper raids → security chase + small fine; 13 affirmative-action houses (month 1, stochastic); scrapper rent 5,000 scrap / 13 days at the Ministry; missed rent = achievement + 24h eviction; inactivity: free property (huts, Tenure units) is lost after 13 days with no in-game access — paid lots are NEVER lost to inactivity (Kevin, Nov 6)
Food, water, oxygen (+1 TBD) gate jobs and XP (not drops); equal daily cap for everyone; gentry get theirs conveniently, scrappers through risk
Death = account deletion: counted and announced by skiff number only; credits forfeited, lots to market, number to a 69h auction

13 recreation zones (see wiki): driving range, Church of 13, Church of the Dog, Regeneration Center, Black Site 13 (Snake), AstroTurf Center, Militia, Imaging Research + 5 TBD. Record boards local first, global with the server

Civic Warmth™ consequences (design first). Ideas: low warmth → Null Sector drones faster/earlier, shuttle routes and Tenure Heights locked, higher Ministry fees, public 'Cold List'; high warmth → priority freight/shuttle offers, Ministry fast-track, heat-free visits to Tenure Heights, a seat on the Bulletin. Never real-money effects; no edge on lot buying
Most Humane Citizen of the Day picked server-side from real pilots (biggest warmth gain); shown by skiff number unless the pilot opts in to a display name; ties broken by earliest
Opt-in e-mailed certificate for the Citizen of the Day (express consent, unsubscribe, sender ID per CASL; transactional wording only, no marketing in it)
Real accounts import SQ1- pilot codes from the on-device Pilots screen (no progress lost from staging)
Shuttle crowds (and other 'pilots around' modifiers) use the real online count from the server instead of the simulated daily curve
Decide what the allotment resource is (water / air / rations / power?) and what it's for; tie the magnet's neighbours to real players' huts

phases.name: Phase 3 — Real economy
phases.goal: Money in, credits out, everything transparent.

items.text: Payments behind one interface, test mode first (Stripe / Paddle / Helcim)
Credits ledger as a liability: no expiry, no dormancy fees
Terms: licence not property, buy-out risk acknowledgement, refunds
GST/HST registration plan, accountant on credit accounting
Public stats that are actually accurate (Competition Act)
Cosmetic skins for purchase, incl. custom (through branding consent + moderation; Sprawl rule TBD)
Model the $1 economy before launch (staging price; real revenue implications)
Paper certificate for purchase (print-on-demand partner, shipping + sales tax, refund policy; Competition Act price display incl. fees)

phases.name: Phase 4 — Trust, safety & legal
phases.goal: A free-speech zone that can't be taken down by the obvious stuff.

items.text: In-game reporting; auto-hide on CSAM/violence reports
Daily automated scan incl. CSAM hash-matching on logos
Biweekly human review; faster track for legal/defamation notices
Written C3P / Mandatory Reporting Act procedure
Separate entity from Prime Rogue; privacy policy (PIPA/PIPEDA); French UI
Lawyer pass on payments/securities before cash ever moves
Remove noindex + robots block, OG images, landing page
Launch plan (ads? press? creators?)

STRETCH: The Charter of 13. The first 13 gentry to hold 13 buildings of 13+ floors can apply to the corporate registry to have their real-world business incorporated in-game as a third list of organizations (alongside corps and government). Kept even if they later lose property. They suggest a function; we build around it. Needs: contest rules (Competition Act s.74.06), Quebec publicity-contest check, written licence + content standards
Lift economy.js into a shared core package
Clone 2: new setting, same rules
Umbrella brand once Clone 2 exists

parking: Seasonal bulletin events (strikes, blackouts, Corp audits)
Leaderboards: best lap, most freight, longest-held lot
Hut interiors / visiting other players' huts
Lot history replay: watch a building change hands over time
Science Centre landmark: EVA certification mission line
Upgrade fitting at your hut, not just the Refit Bay
169 hidden achievements, some of which may never be built (players can't tell which)

releases.name: Your plot: hut-tier unlocks, scrap magnet, house number colour
items: Every hut tier unlocks one thing on your plot (data/plot-unlocks.json): preset cosmetics (never branding) and allotment fixtures

Tier 1: scrap magnet: passive scrap in 13-minute windows shaped by magnetic weather, hut tier, the bulletin, nearby drops, neighbours' magnets (compete) and detectors (resonate); random surges and oddities; rusts if you don't collect (faster after 13 h); runs while you're away, seeded so reloads can't reroll it
Tier 2: house number colour (only the colour; nobody tells you why)
Allotment fixtures guarantee a minimum of the allotment resource (name TBD) per day, banked up to 13 days, collected at the hut; HUD row
Magnet pile shows on the gig board when it's worth collecting or rusting

releases.name: Overcrowding, the manifest, souls count, scooters
items: Shuttles can be overcrowded: 13 seats, up to 26 aboard; standing passengers make it heavier, slower to stop, touchier (comfort losses up to 2×, slower recovery) and pay more fares; crowd chatter
Passengers are people: name, faction, age (18+), job, home, one detail; speech bubbles name the speaker
Void dumps show the Manifest of the Departed; 'souls lost on your watch' counted permanently (HUD row, residency card, Civic Warmth)
Last Mile Scoot rentals: 39 dockless scooters; F to ride (1 scrap + 1 per 13 s); twitchy, battery drains, wall at speed = wipeout; F into a ship parks it, X ends the ride (tug fee)
Juicing gig: load low/wrecked scooters in your skiff (hold 3), drop at 5 Scoot Docks for scrap; void wrecks pay most
Passengers bring scooters aboard (take a place, fall over on hard corners, fly out in the void as wrecks)
Achievements: Sardine Can, Micromobility, Juicer; shame: Faceplant, Body Count (13), Grim Statistic (169)

releases.name: Pilots (sign-in on this device), passenger chatter, easier docking
items: Pilots (P / ☰): sign in as a pilot on this device; new pilot = fresh start; switch; wipe with automatic backup (last 5, restorable); export/import a pilot code (share, copy or download) to protect it or move devices

Shuttle passenger chatter: 14 factions, 219 lines (praise, heckles, jokes, boarding, late), speech bubbles + feed; reacts to walls, hard corners, smooth streaks and running over par; data/passengers.json
Comfort retuned: scores what passengers feel, not steering corrections
Docking: bigger pad reach (×1.8 on touch, ×1.3 on PC) and a docking assist that settles a slow, coasting ship onto the pad
Achievements: Bus Lane Grand Prix (valid racetrack lap in a shuttle mid-route); Dark Lord of Transit (hidden shame: open a full shuttle's doors in the void)
Shuttle crowds scale with pilots around (simulated daily curve until the server); seats 13; fares 3 scrap a head; deadheading (nobody delivered) = half pay, no bonus
VIPs (13% a run, at the depot or the first city stop): pay ×1.5, +39 if delivered 80%+ comfortable, feel bumps 1.5×, talk a lot
X opens the doors instead of ending the route: everyone gets off, the route carries on empty, new passengers board at the next stops; X on an empty shuttle abandons
A VIP who dies (comfort hits 0, or ejected in the void): −130 Civic Warmth, 3 heat stars, −13 career points, secret honour 'Eat the Rich' (130 scrap + Silver-spoon hood ornament)
Achievements: VIP Treatment, Standing Room Only, Eat the Rich (secret)

releases.name: Mobile: touch controls, portrait + landscape
items: Touch controls on phones/tablets (auto-detected; ?touch forces them): heading stick (point where you want to go), BRAKE, E (glows when usable), F jump, X dump/abandon
☰ menu with every keyboard menu (gigs, card, achievements, warmth, lap boards, ledger, wiki, clear waypoint, help, full screen; staging notes/roadmap)
Responsive layouts for portrait and landscape: compact HUD, minimap top-right, last 3 log lines, gig board as a collapsible overlay, full-width modals
Camera zooms out on small screens so you see more of the world

releases.name: Humane Shuttle + Civic Warmth™
items: Humane Shuttle runs: depots in both Sprawls; 3 random hub routes per depot every 13 min (Sprawl stop → maybe the Halfway Halt → city gate → 1–3 crossings → terminal)
The shuttle handles like dog shit: laggy steering, pulls left, wobbles, slides, weak brakes
Base pay + bonus for comfort ≥ 70% AND under par; comfort drops on wall hits, hard cornering, brake slams; 0% = passengers walk (run failed)
Career with the Humane Transit Directorate (Ministry of the Gentry): 13 ranks, +4% pay per rank, each rank a slightly less awful shuttle
Civic Warmth™ (K) by the Bureau of Public Cheer: 0–1300, 13 tiers (Frozen Out → Incandescent), start 650; contributing warms, degeneracy cools; HUD row + daily ledger
Most Humane Citizen of the Day on the gig board and in the feed (seeded until accounts); printable certificate if you out-warm the pick
8 achievements (4 shuttle, 2 warmth; shame: Passenger Incident, Frozen Out)

releases.name: Gig board
items: Gig board (G): one list for every open gig, up to 13 rows with a mix of types; sort by nearest or best pay
Track one gig at a time: it gets the flag + arrow; onboarding mission tracked by default; Q / chip buttons to untrack
Per-type 'on map' toggles (Freight, Drops, Races, Stamps); freight offers list-only by default
Freight: up to 5 offers at once, expiring after ~1.5–2 min; fly to any pickup pad to load (no more single pushed offer / X to decline)
Drops listed by sector only; log trimmed to events
Marker chips above the minimap with clear / hide / untrack buttons; waypoint distances in metres

releases.name: Racetracks + art backfill
items: Two racetracks south of the main drag: The Island Circuit (after Circuit Gilles-Villeneuve) and The Temple Circuit (after Monza)
Start gate in the race direction starts a lap; 13 gates in order; wrong-way detection; laps void if you leave the circuit or your ship
Leaderboards (B / E at the timing board): local laps vs. 12 seeded org rival pilots; shared board needs accounts + server
6 new achievements (Lights Out, Wall of Champions, Temple of Speed, Podium, P1; shame: Wrong Way)
Art backfill: 13 org emblems, 13 achievement-category icons, Tenure Heights (2×4), owner homes (4), deck props (8); owner-home art for lot owners living in a Sprawl
World extends south to y=6800 for the Raceway

releases.name: Residency card + achievements
items: Residency card (C): 13 stamps, one per organization; Level 0.00 → 0.13 → Level 1 “Fully Processed” (+130 scrap)
10 org desks on the Spine, one per block (Ministry north of the Spine, in the heat zone: +1 star); Kessler, Mercy, Registry stamp at their real places
Stand-in desk actions where the system doesn't exist yet (Foundry shift, ration, oath, bid, Meter Office)
Achievements (J): data/achievements.json, 13 categories × 13 known + 169 hidden; 48 live, the rest 'unannounced'
Shame achievements hidden until earned, pay a cosmetic once (cosmetics recorded, rendering later); the rest pay scrap
HUD level shows residency until processed, then your XP level

releases.name: Rule of 13
items: The Spine: 13 blocks of 13 lots (169, north side), owned by the 13 organizations
12 crossings cut through the Spine between blocks (placeholder until north-south roads + intersections)
Two Sprawls, same ~1 min flight from each city limit: Lower Upper Squalor (east), Upper Lower Squalor (west); 39 sites each (13×3), a Housing Registry each
13 sector columns (A–M); city minimap scrolls, with a whole-Spine strip
13 tiers per skiff upgrade; 13 hut tiers (Lean-to → The Big Bunker); Hull VII drone tap
13 drops per 130 s (one per sector column, 13–39 scrap); $13 test cash; towers start at 13 floors (max 100)
Spine Run: 13 gates slaloming through the crossings; freight stays within ~2 blocks

releases.name: Onboarding flow — part 1
items: Mission 1: scrounge 120 scrap (~2–3 min) → fit first upgrade at the Kessler Refit Bay
Mission 2: "for now, you need a home": 150 scrap → build a hut in the Sprawl (~1 min flight)
Onboarding immune to Corp Bulletin drop modifiers (rookies get base rate; world stays shared)
Objective flag: world flag + screen-edge arrow with distance + minimap flag; scrounge steps point at the reported sector, not the drop
Upgrade costs scaled ~3× (Gyros I = 120)
Sprawl Housing Registry at the west entrance: grid of all 80 sites, pick any vacant one (auto-opens on arrival during mission 2)
Fixes: drops are a single E press (75px, speed <5); freight pads + clocks tuned for the starter skiff

releases.name: Starter skiff, $1 lots, jumps
items: $1 lots, ×1.25 buy-outs in cents, skyline heights, NPC $1 claims, $10 test cash
Skiff #001 bad-on-purpose handling + scrap-only upgrades (Gyros, Dampeners, Thrusters, Hull; Road chassis locked)
Ship-to-ship jump (<3s), temporary stolen ships, impound/tow on bust
Corp lore in the ledger; staging tools (N notes, R roadmap/costs)

releases.name: Clone 1 sandbox → SpaceSquat
items: Flight, Spine lots, buy-outs + credits, ledger, drops, levelling
Freight, heat, Spine Run; the Sprawl; generated sprite art; rename to SpaceSquat

releases.name: Gig board that behaves on phones
items: Swiping the gig list scrolls it; only a clean tap tracks a gig
Board no longer rebuilds every quarter second: distances and timers update in place, scroll position kept (also lighter on PC)
Phones: picking a gig closes the board; tapping the world closes it too
Phones: one-line rows, half-screen max height, no citizen banner or sub-lines in the board
New-gig badge only counts gigs worth a look (not churning freight, drops, scooters, races)

releases.name: The Assessor's number is 1.13
items: Buy-outs are 1.13× the current value everywhere (was 1.25×); lot cards, rules panel, wiki, lore and passenger jokes updated
Skiff upgrade and hut tier costs keep their own ×1.25 curve, so nothing you build with scrap got cheaper
World regenerated so seeded lot histories use 1.13×

releases.name: The Architects + roof logos
items: Prime Rogue Inc. (north) and Wilco Corporation (south) campuses just off the Atlas, each at the end of its own Nerve from the crossings either side of block 7
Each tower is a four-lot square (2 × 2), 130 floors, solid, never for sale; dock at the pad for the Architect's card (E)
Placeholder art until Kevin's sprites land: monogram logos, procedural roofs (Prime Rogue's top-floor lights left on; Wilco's bone-shaped pad)
Roof logo upload in the branding editor: squared to 256 px and re-encoded (strips metadata); stays on this device until accounts + the automated scan exist; cleared on buy-out
Architects in the wiki (L → architects), docs/WIKI.md, places (the Atlas, the Nerves) and glossary
Achievements: Pilgrim (dock at both campuses), Brand Identity (put a logo on your roof)

tracks.name: Track: Non-Volunteer Volunteer Militia
tracks.note: Separate progression for the truly devoted. Allegiance is to one corporation. 13 ranks, obviously.

items.text: Swear allegiance to one corporation's militia company (changing sides: TBD, probably a 13-day cooldown + a fine)
Weekly shooting qualification; skipping is fined in scrap (never below zero; only for players active that week)
13 ranks from Conscript-Volunteer to whatever the 13th is; rank cosmetics come through levelling
Shooting range mini-game (targets, record board)
Rank duties: escort freight, patrol the Spine, assist Null Sector chases (TBD)

tracks.name: Track: Money rollout (after the world is built out)
tracks.note: Nothing is sold until the world is worth buying into. Each step has a gate; don't move on until it passes.

items.text: Step 1 · Fake money on staging: wave board, live lot counter ("17 of 26 left"), 1.13× buy-outs, Launch Parity, all on test cash. Gate: numbers hold under real play, incl. a two-account farming attempt

Step 2 · Stripe test mode: server-side checkout + webhooks, sign-in before checkout, purchase limits, auto credit freeze on dispute. Gate: dispute freezes credits, refund takes the lot back, a burst of cheap test charges is blocked
Step 3 · Live smoke test: a few real charges on Kevin's own cards in the separate SpaceSquat Stripe account, then refund. Gate: USD lands in the payout account, fees match
Step 4 · Public launch, founders' wave: terms, Launch Parity rules and the full wave schedule published the same day; counter starts
Step 5 · Watch weekly: credits outstanding, buy-outs/week, fee share of revenue, dispute rate (well under 1%), Parity vouchers claimed of 468
Minimum card charge $4.13; smaller buy-outs paid from credits or the remainder goes to the buyer's credits (a $1.28 buy-out loses ~¼ to Stripe)
Gate for launch: real-time avenue opening (fewer than 13 Spine lots left → next parallels) must work on day 1; 195 launch lots > 169 Spine lots
Don't sell credit packs (buy-out credits are store credit; purchased credits may fall under provincial gift-card rules). Ask accountant/lawyer, plus GST/HST ($30k small-supplier threshold)

69-floor promo (Kevin, Nov 7): Spine price fixed (assumed $13). The 69 sale covers the first five newly opened avenue blocks, each doubling the one before: $13 → $26 → $52 → $104 → $208. No end date: it ends when the next doubling ($416) would cost more than buying 69 floors one at a time (~$228). From block 6 on, floors sell normally. Published rule: "the 69 sale covers the first five new blocks"
